name: Oaken Skin (Floral)
body:
Sunlight nourishes and invigorates your flesh, toughening it into respectable armor in its own right.

Prerequisite(s): Bond of Flora

Benefit(s): Your skin, already the texture of bark, only needs to bask in the sun to be strong enough to turn aside blows. You gain a +2 natural armor bonus to AC as long as you get 4 hours of sunlight in any 24 hour period.

Call of the Wild, Book 1 – The Druid. © 2017 d20pfsrd.com Publishing; Author: Kalen Tessmann
